---
name: format-jira-text
description: ALWAYS use this when drafting or writing ANY text destined for a Jira field: a ticket summary or description, a comment, or a custom field. Not an optional post-processing step, it is part of producing the draft, including short drafts and ones where the user asked for brevity. Converts the draft into Jira wiki markup (headings, *strong*, {{monospaced}}, {code} blocks, tables, lists, links) and copies it to the macOS clipboard as plain text. Triggers on "draft a ticket", "write a ticket", "ticket for", "jira description", "jira comment", "format for jira", "jira markup", "copy to jira", "wiki markup".
---

# Jira text

Convert the draft to wiki markup, then copy it.
